newsitem.title: CANADA: Potash faces objections to K&S deal.
newsitem.headline: Potash faces objections to K&S deal.

text.p: Potash Corp of Saskatchewan Inc said on Wednesday it had received a statement of objections from the German Federal Cartel Office summarizing its preliminary reasons for a possible prohibition order of Potash Corp's proposed acquisition of 51 percent of the outstanding shares of Kali und Salz Beteilingungs AG from a subsidiary of BASF AG.
Potash Corp and BASF have until January 27, 1997 to reply to the statement of objections to the takeover of the fertilizer business, Potash Corp said.

"We are disappointed with the initial reaction of the German Federal Cartel office; however, it is important to realize that this is not a final decision," Potash Corp president and chief executive Charles Childers said. "It is our belief that the German potash industry would benefit concerns that have been raised and to complete the transaction to the benefit of all parties."

BASF and Potash Corp have made the necessary filings under the Hart-Scott-Rodino Antitrust Improvements Act and the waiting period expired at midnight January 12, Potash Corp said. It said the deal has been submitted to the Canadian and German regulatory authorities and discussions are continuing.
